description: Exact upstream pixel-parity literals that are deliberately exempt from the generic component-style baseline. This is not a second debt ledger: every entry names one file, rule, property, value and bounded count, the pinned upstream source, the owning issue, a reason and a review date. Globs, prefixes and wildcards are rejected by scripts/ci/style-parity-allowlist.mjs; a warning that is not listed here fails `pnpm lint:style` unless it is already in tests/style/component-style-baseline.json (legacy debt, shrink-only).

entries.reason: The pinned PPTX toolbar and SelectTrigger use Tailwind ring/shadow-xs/shadow-lg utilities; their 1/2/3/10/15px offsets and the two 1px inner-ring pseudo elements are upstream pixel geometry, and the token layer has no ring/shadow utility scale that reproduces them without changing computed box-shadow.

Two 1px ring-clip radii are derived from the upstream rounded-lg trigger, and the PPTX-only hidden-slide pill uses 999px; replacing the derived radii changes computed geometry and the pinned reference has no hidden-slide control to compare against. Both are part of the #161b freeze.

The upstream FileThumbnail/card hover and active transitions are Tailwind duration-150 utilities. The 0.8 token layer intentionally has no transition-duration token, so 150ms is the parity value and stays literal until a duration token lands.
